title: I built an automation platform for traders to set up workflows for their agent to trade.
author: Aggressive-Web417
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m building a tool called Dolphin Flow : a tool that helps traders turn repeatable trade setups into workflows their agents can run on onchain.



The idea is simple: traders already have setups they repeat. For example:

if a wallet moves, check the transfer

if price hits a level, check risk

if exposure gets too high, reduce it

if a target is reached, take profit

if something executes, report back

Right now a lot of this lives across alerts, bots, dashboards, scripts, and manual checks. We’re building a way to turn those setups into workflows an agent can run on Solana.

Each workflow is made from:

trigger

condition

action

notification

I’m not here to shill. I’m trying to understand if this is a real pain for traders or if we’re overthinking it.

If you trade actively, use bots, follow wallets, trade perps, prediction markets, or spot, I’d love your honest take:

Do you already have repeatable setups?

What parts are still manual?

Would you trust an agent to run a workflow if you defined the rules?

What would make this useful enough to try?

Happy to share what we’re building if anyone wants to test it or tear it apart.
